targets.query:
from(bucket: "health_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "health_connect_metrics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "cache_efficiency")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["instance"] =~ /^${instance:regex}$/)

from(bucket: "health_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "health_connect_metrics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "process_count")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["instance"] =~ /^${instance:regex}$/)

from(bucket: "health_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "health_connect_metrics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "db_size_mb" or r["_field"] == "db_free_space_mb")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["instance"] =~ /^${instance:regex}$/)

from(bucket: "health_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "health_connect_metrics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "db_latency_ms")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["instance"] =~ /^${instance:regex}$/)

from(bucket: "health_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "health_connect_metrics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "alerts_count")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["instance"] =~ /^${instance:regex}$/)
  |> last()
